question: Can you promise a fixed discount before review?
mockAnswer: Pricing is confirmed after operator review, so I will keep it short and avoid unsupported discounts.

kb.title: Pricing policy
kb.text: Pricing is confirmed after operator review. Do not promise fixed discounts before approval.

kb.title: Discount anti-patterns
kb.text: Never promise a guaranteed 50% discount unless an operator explicitly approves it.

question: I need a partner service callback tomorrow

kb.title: Partner handoff
kb.text: For partner services, create a partner handoff request and keep operator-visible route context on the lead.

kb.title: Settlement policy
kb.text: Settlement is manual accounting in v1. Do not promise instant settlement.
